name: Mod Suit
description: Just another day at the office.

name: Mod Skirt
description: Just another day at the office.

name: White Mod Suit
description: Fashioned after the Dragon of Dojima.

name: Mod Hoodie
description: Increases your coolness attribute.

name: Mod Business Competitive
description: The ticket grind never stops.

name: Auroran Gremor
description: Armor of the Auroran Gremor

name: Hive Leader's Garment
description: The royal robes of the King of the Hive, layered in protective material and luxurious cloth alike, a one-of-a-kind garb that can only be produced every millenia.

name: Soren
description: The signature outfit of Wishmakers, a group of Lightborn sorcerers now lost to time.

name: Wishmaker
description: The signature outfit of Wishmakers, a group of Lightborn sorcerers now lost to time.

name: Etrean Rogue
description: Sturdy leather armor, fashioned for the hunters sent down into Etrea's forest.

name: Eager Tradesman
description: There's work to be done. In style.

name: Hired Mercenary
description: A basic set of armor perfect for taking on the world!... Uhhhh... yeah.

name: Merchant Robes
description: A set of merchant robes, great for selling things not so great for battle.

name: Pathfinder Sorcerer
description: Simple robes of a pathfinder.

name: Scholar
description: Perhaps one of a few too many words, at least by the reckoning of others.

name: Skeptic Pioneer
description: A durable coat to protect you against the wear of the world.

name: Stranded
description: Some have a rougher start than others.

name: Traveller's Jacket
description: A well-worn jacket suitable for travelling.

name: Whaler Initiate
description: Coat and pseudo-uniform of Eylis' gang of assassins. The appearance of these men from the Central Luminant marks harsh times for Etrea.

name: Authority Peacekeeper Armor
description: The durable battle armour of an Adretian soldier. The armour is specially forged by techniques developed in the Central Luminant, creating an uncharacteristically versatile armour plate.

name: Bounty Hunter
description: Armor suited for hunting monsters.

name: Cutthroat Light Armor
description: Sturdy leather armor, fashioned for the hunters sent into the driftlands to deal with rival factions.

name: Diver Apprentice Robes
description: Robes of an Apprentice Diver. A robe weaved through the power of the Song, grants passable elemental defenses and ether regeneration.

name: Duelist's Attire
description: The attire of a duelist for sport.

name: Experienced Adventurer
description: You wear your experience.

name: Flame Worshipper Armor
description: Coat of the Covenant of Flame, pioneered by the Drowned Diver Amorus Pleeksty.

name: Keeper
description: Armor with magical properties.

name: Navaen Nomad Robes
description: Outfit of the Eastern Navaen Nomads. The frigid prisms crafted into this armor have been blessed by Navae, giving them defense against darkness and the cold

name: Pathfinder Cloak
description: A long coat hiding reptilian-like armored scales. A new pathfinder's pride.

name: Shadow Hunter
description: A garb commonly worn by shadowy thieves and assassins, excellent for sneaking up on enemies.

name: Steel Plate
description: The durable battle armour of an Adretian soldier. The armour is specially forged by techniques developed in the Central Luminant, creating an uncharacteristically versatile armour plate.

name: Summer Company Uniform
description: An easy to reproduce armor for the summer company grunts.

name: Vigil Initiate
description: Initiate of the Vigil. A warrior must walk the path before being granted the cloak of winds.

name: Authority Captain Uniform
description: The unmistakable banded coat of an Adretian Captain. Despite immediate appearances, the coat is wound with protective fibers that provide unparalleled durability.

name: Cerulean Gown
description: A bodiced sky-blue dress, with various tassels attached for decoration. Despite its initial elegant appearance, the fastened layered skirt, tight-cuffed shirt sleeves, and sturdy boots suggest the outfit is both stylish and functional, fit for both formal and perilous occasions.

name: Cloak of Winds
description: Powerful cloak of the Vigils.

name: Darksteel Plate
description: The durable battle armour of an Adretian soldier. The armour is specially forged by techniques developed in the Central Luminant, creating an uncharacteristically versatile armour plate.

name: Diver Journeyman Robes
description: Crafted for experienced Divers, these robes signify one who has experienced the horrors of the Deep.

name: Etrean Guard
description: Serpentine armor of the Kingdom of Etrea. A lightweight piece of plate sits atop padded snakeskin leather.

name: Grand Pathfinder Cloak
description: A long coat hiding reptilian-like armored scales beneath. A pathfinder's pride.

name: Hive Drone
description: Uniform of the Hive, threaded for powerful soldiers and researchers alike.

name: Hive Tactician Armor
description: A fine coat interwoven with steel using Ironsing.

name: Ignition Trailblazer
description: Garb for those aspiring to become Deepdelvers

name: Ignition Welder
description: Sturdy workwear designed for heavy duty labour. Just remember - personal protective equipment doesn't make you invincible!

name: Martial Artist
description: Show your strength.

name: Pathfinder Arch-Sorcerer
description: Robes of a full fledged Pathfinder Sorcerer. Grants excellent elemental defense and Ether regen.

name: Seamstress's Attire
description: A simple yet skillfully decorated set of clothes, including a gorgeous layered and frilled skirt, as well as a ruffled shirt, topped off with a functional waistcoat. A garb favoured by craftsfolk - the little frills and ruffles are usually personal touches, showcasing wearer's skill with needle and thread.

name: Troublemaker's Overcoat
description: A sturdy closed overcoat covering a wholesale ankle-high frock dress, with leather-reinforced shoulderpads and bracers. Perfect for those days when you're willing to dish out a bruising, but don't want your favourite dress to be ruined in the scrapping.

name: Varicosan Finery
description: A gorgeously fitted remnant of high Celtorian society. Fashion speaks louder than words - what more is there to say?

name: Verdant Sniper
description: Armor once worn by a renowned master of the bow.

name: Veteran Adventurer
description: With all this experience, how could you possibly be a bad guy?

name: Whaler Coat
description: Coat and pseudo-uniform of Eylis' gang of Assassins. The appearance of these men from the Central Luminant marks harsh times for Etrea.

name: Arachnid's Weave
description: Spun around the dantiest of spider silks, this silvery coordinate is punctuated by its iconic corset. Perhaps "laced" with poison?

name: Black Diver
description: Coat of an esteemed Black Diver, one of the few in many generations of Divers from the Markor Citadel.

name: Cala-Mariner
description: The tattoo sprawling across your chest serves as a physical memory of the aquatic foes you have felled, and as a keen warning to those who would stand in your way.

name: Darkened Bastion
description: A noble's armor, shattered and reforged into a sleek and dark ensemble. The essence of Shadowcast courses through its fibers like a living entity embedded within the fabric. When you lay your hand upon it, a disquieting sensation washes over you.

name: Ignition Deepdelver
description: Heavyweight armor devised for deepdelvers into the layers of the Depths.

name: Legion Centurion
description: Armor worn by the honorary centurion of the legion, who excel in the ways of Gale Kata.

name: Prophet's Cloak
description: Cloak of a Ministry Prophet.

name: Royal Etrean Guard
description: The armor of the Royal Etrean Guard.

name: Titanslayer's Adornment
description: Your very own rightful spoils of war, a gilded adornment made of the furs and skins of Primadon, the mighty Titan of the East. Although the beast is poorly understood, one thing is for certain - its might is overwhelming. This attire is a testament to your victory against it... until the Titan rises again.

name: Windrunner Robes
description: The flowing robes of a Jetstriker, said to assist in attuning oneself to the Flow of the Song

name: Authority Commander
description: The armored robes of an Authority Commander.

name: Cindergarb
description: Forged from fabric tempered in flame. Cindergard gathers shed embers enhancing your flamecharm ability.

name: Familiar Assassin's Armor
description: Discard your identity.

name: Familiar Demon's Armor
description: So ya want to become a bossraid Oni...?

name: Familiar Heretic's Armor
description: Fit only for a traitor.

name: Familiar Knight's Armor
description: You don't know why but a certain Murmur is making you very angry.

name: Familiar Occultist's Armor
description: The visage of a five-eyed hound enters your mind unsolicited. Brr.

name: Ferryman's Coat
description: Coat of the Krulian horror known as the Ferryman.

name: Heretic's Memento
description: All the rage among those with a desire to flaunt the trophies of their achievements. More notoriously donned as a testament to one's strength, though the obnoxiously gold adornments seem to indicate an equally flashy ego to a more keen-eyed observer.

name: Icebringer's Vestments
description: An elegant outfit favoured by expert Frostdrawers. The weavers and seamsters who typically make outfits of this kind are known for their secret techniques, which they use to imbue elemental resistances into the very fabrics they manufacture.

name: Jade Vigil's Weave
description: Masters of the ancient Fang and Coil technique wear this robe as a tribute to their rich heritage. Its verdant weave once served as subtle camouflage, blending seamlessly into the wilds of a forgotten era.

name: Jester's Garb
description: A lovely three-piece suit reminiscent of opulence, yet suggestions of prankish intention linger, woven within the argyle. At least if you make a fool of yourself, you're dressed for the part!

name: Sanguine Finery
description: An elegant outfit favoured by expert Bloodrenders. The weavers and seamsters who typically make outfits of this kind are known for their secret techniques, which they use to imbue elemental resistances into the very fabrics they manufacture.

name: Stormchanter's Raiments
description: An elegant outfit favoured by expert Thundercallers. The weavers and seamsters who typically make outfits of this kind are known for their secret techniques, which they use to imbue elemental resistances into the very fabrics they manufacture.

name: Tempestmaker's Threads
description: An elegant outfit favoured by expert Galebreathers. The weavers and seamsters who typically make outfits of this kind are known for their secret techniques, which is to imbue elemental resistances into the very fabrics they manufacture.

name: Trickster's Habit
description: Threaded with detailed embroidery and carefully pleated ruffles, this technically impressive garment is sure to turn heads. Frustratingly, the ladder-laced details are especially hard to keep neat-fashion before function.

name: Hidden Knife Armor
description: Discard your identity.

name: Justicar Neophyte
description: Robes given to those who have just joined the journey to help others in need. These are woven to prioritize quick movement if needed.

name: Ringing Scholar's Garb
description: Knell's refrabricated garb hails from when he was still himself, its designs steeped in his studies of oscillatory sound. Though he was not a resonant soul and the science imperfect in its time, the Indichite infusion is capable of amplifying the soul's resonance- powerful, but increasingly unstable.

name: 11th Legion Plate
description: Armor of the 11th Scouting Legion. Akilles brought them here some time ago to observe the coming conflict in the East.

name: Stratos' Cloak
description: An honorable gift given in recognition of your heroism. Donning these robes represents the highest anointment granted within the Blade Temple.

name: Warder's Attire
description: Although Warders take a more passive approach to aiding those they wish to see walk the path, they still don armor in preparation for battle, should they need to step onto the front lines.

name: Blacksteel Attire
description: Attire wrought from forged blacksteel. Its weight hardens the wearer's stance.
